body.query: Who led FriskAI's latest funding round?

results.title: FriskAI launches with $3.6M to show enterprises what their AI agents are doing - SiliconANGLE
results.author: Duncan Riley
highlights: MaC Venture Capital Management led FriskAI’s round. Wischoff Ventures joined, along with New Enterprise Associates Inc. partner Rick Yang and a group of angel investors. Marlon Nichols, managing partner at MaC Venture Capital, likened the opportunity to what Amazon Web Services Inc. was to cloud and Cisco Systems Inc. was to the early internet and said the FriskAI team has built “the infrastructure layer that lets companies see what their agents are doing.” The company’s website also lists Detroit Venture Partners among its backers.

results.title: FriskAI raises $3.6M from MaC Venture Capital to watch what AI agents do — TFN
results.author: Abhinaya Prabhu
highlights:
# FriskAI raises $3.6M from MaC Venture Capital to watch what AI agents do
...
- FriskAI emerged from stealth with $3.6 million in pre-seed funding to track what AI agents do once deployed.
- MaC Venture Capital led the round, targeting the healthcare, insurance, and finance sectors.
- It joins a field that has raised over $175 million in 2026 alone.
